meta.title: Free diagnostic session for your project | Cyrrus
meta.description: A free 60-minute session with a senior Cyrrus consultant to decide how to approach your ERP, CRM or transformation project. No commitment.

hero.title: Free diagnostic session
hero.description: Sixty minutes with a senior Cyrrus consultant to clarify the decision you have pending: what's at stake, what to resolve first and what the sensible next step is. No cost and no commitment.

who.title: For anyone facing a big decision
items: General managers, CEOs, CFOs, COOs and IT directors of companies with more than 50 employees.
With a technology or transformation decision in the next twelve months: choosing or replacing an ERP or CRM, migrating a system, getting a project back under control.
Who want an independent second opinion before requesting proposals or signing a contract.
who.notTitle: When this isn't the right session
who.notText: If you're looking for a license quote or a vendor to implement right away, this isn't the conversation: Cyrrus doesn't resell licenses or take commissions from vendors.

steps.title: Your context
steps.description: What decision you have pending, which systems you use today, who is involved and what happens if nothing is decided.

steps.title: The risks
steps.description: Together we review the five foundations of any systems project (processes, data, team, budget and sponsorship) and where your gaps are.

steps.title: The next step
steps.description: We tell you frankly what we would do in your place, even if the recommendation doesn't include hiring us.

take.title: Something useful, whether or not you hire us
items: An honest read of your situation and of the decisions to make first.
A one-page note with the findings and recommended steps, within the next three business days.
If it makes sense, a proposal for how we could support you, with clear scope and price and no pressure.

items.question: Is it really free?
items.answer: Yes. The session has no cost or obligation. If you later want to work with us, we present a proposal with scope and price; if not, you keep the findings note.

items.question: Who leads the session?
items.answer: A senior Cyrrus consultant. It isn't a sales call: the goal is for you to leave with more clarity about your decision.

items.question: What do I need to prepare?
items.answer: Nothing is mandatory. It helps to bring the pending decision, the systems you use today and the people involved. If you like, take the ERP readiness test first.

items.question: Does Cyrrus take commissions from software vendors?
items.answer: No. Cyrrus doesn't resell licenses or take commissions from any vendor, so its recommendation doesn't depend on which product is chosen.

items.question: Is what I discuss confidential?
items.answer: Yes. The information you share in the session is not disclosed and is handled under our privacy policy.
